subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to file consent upload requests

question: Should this PR establish the canonical Microsoft Teams SharePoint transfer deadline before https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104288, and is a five-minute base plus 256 KiB/s transfer budget an acceptable fail-closed policy?
rationale: Tests and transport proof establish implementation correctness, but only a Microsoft Teams owner can accept the slow-transfer compatibility boundary and choose which overlapping PR owns the shared helper first.

options.title: Land consent timeout first
options.body: Merge this smaller, proven timeout-owner change, then rebase the broader SharePoint-send PR to reuse it and resolve overlap.

options.title: Land broader SharePoint PR first
options.body: Merge the broader sibling first, then rebase this PR so it contains only the consent-path integration and distinct tests.

recommendation.title: Land consent timeout first
recommendation.body: Merge this smaller, proven timeout-owner change, then rebase the broader SharePoint-send PR to reuse it and resolve overlap.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available recent history on adjacent Microsoft Teams attachment networking and request-boundary behavior.
